items.details: Mark booked everything through Marigold Hotel/Amrit Tours in Pokhara; arranged permits and a guide ($20/day, 5 days = $100). Rooms around 700 Rupees.
items.name: Marigold Hotel (Amrit Tours)

items.details: Started at about 8 am; taxi cost 1,500 Nepali Rupees. Trekking time about 5-6 hours.
items.name: Taxi from Pokhara to Nayapul

items.details: Small house restaurant lunch stop; vegetarian dal bhat for 300 Rupees, all the rice he could eat.
items.name: Green Land Restaurant

items.details: Double room 350 Rupees; dinner of plain rice (150), stir fried veg noodles (270), tea (50).
items.name: Tikhedunga Guest House

items.details: Walked straight up the mountain ~4 hours, glimpses of snow-capped Annapurna peaks; lunch of sukuti (dry buffalo) fried with onions and spices for 400 Rupees; total hiking 7-8 hours.
items.name: Hike Tikhedunga to Ghorepani

items.details: Top of the village in the main square area; 300 Rupees room, 100 Rupees hot shower; dinner of vegetable fried rice (260) and milk tea (60).
items.name: Dhaulagiri Lodge

items.details: 5 am climb (45 minutes) to 3,210m summit for sunrise over the Annapurna range; then hiked the parallel ridge down to Gandruk; lunch of vegetarian dal bhat for 360 Rupees; total hiking 10-12 hours.
items.name: Sunrise at Poon Hill summit

items.details: 350 Rupees per night.
items.name: Muna Hotel

items.details: Mostly downhill stone steps through small villages and farms; breakfast of dal baht (360 Rupees); total hiking about 10 hours.
items.name: Hike Gandruk to Deurali

items.details: Room 350 Rupees; dinner of Tibet bread (140) and omelet with rice (320).
items.name: Hotel Trekkers Inn

items.details: About an hour to the permit check town of Pothana, then onward to the Annapurna Eco Village (1,000 Rupees/night, stayed 1 night) before catching a taxi back to Pokhara.
items.name: Hike Deurali to Pothana, taxi to Pokhara

itineraries.summary: Mark Wiens's day-by-day itinerary for his 5-day Ghorepani Poon Hill trek (mid-March 2013) starting from Pokhara: Nayapul to Tikhedunga, up to Ghorepani, sunrise at Poon Hill then on to Gandruk, Gandruk to Deurali, and back to Pokhara. Includes the lodges they stayed in, meals eaten, and costs, plus prep/permit/gear guidance.
itineraries.title: Ghorepani Poon Hill Trek - Ultimate Guide and Itinerary

items.details: Hotel tip: stay at Serena Hotels in both Gilgit and in Karimabad (Hunza Valley) - 1st and 4th nights in Gilgit, 2nd and 3rd nights in Hunza. A Toyota Prado with private driver cost ~30,000 PKR per day (90,000 PKR for 3 full days).
items.name: Serena Hotel

items.details: Begin the drive in Gilgit, reach Karimabad in the early afternoon; stop for chapshoro meat pies, local dry fruit (grapes, berries, apples, 'queen apples') and dud pathi milk tea along the way. Alternative: fly Islamabad to Gilgit to halve the 24+ hour capital drive.
items.name: Drive Gilgit to Karimabad (Hunza Valley)

items.details: Finish day 1 at Eagle's Nest (arrive at least 30 minutes before sunset) for a mind-blowing Karakoram range view; wake in Hunza for a local breakfast of 'gyal' and tea with an early morning view of Mt. Rakaposhi.
items.name: Eagle's Nest viewpoint and Mt. Rakaposhi

items.details: Stay at Serena in Karimabad (2nd and 3rd nights of the trip).
items.name: Serena Hotel

items.details: First stop of day 2; boat tour available (~2,000 PKR for the entire boat, holds ~15 people), then dud pathi milk tea with hot roti cakes or a shared egg omelette at the cafe near the parking area.
items.name: Attabad Lake

items.details: Recommended lunch stop: a small home-cooking restaurant on the left (heading north) just past the large Sost petrol station - no English sign as of Oct 2018; curried kidney beans, yellow/black lentils, potato stew, with hot roti, red onions and green chilies.
items.name: Vegetarian restaurant in Sost

items.details: Climb to just over 16,000 feet (4,800m); stop at local police checkpoint; walk/jog ~500m to the Pakistan-China border gate (extreme altitude, -25C at their visit).
items.name: The Final Climb to Khunjerab Pass

items.details: Arranged earlier with an ethnic Pamir family/couple: home-cooked meal of Balti and Pamiri traditional foods from a restaurant-style menu.
items.name: Dinner with a local Pamiri family

itineraries.summary: Mark Wiens's day-by-day driving itinerary along the Karakoram Highway: day 1 drive Gilgit to Karimabad/Hunza, day 2 Attabad Lake, Sost lunch, and the climb to the Khunjerab Pass (Pakistan-China border, 4,800m), with hotel tips for Serena Hotels in Gilgit and Karimabad and food stops like chapshoro meat pies and dud pathi milk tea.
itineraries.title: Karakoram Mountains of Pakistan - Guide to the Khunjerab Pass

items.details: Budget option where they stayed; higher-end option: Burasari Heritage Luang Prabang.
items.name: Apple Guest House

items.details: Climb the stairs (10-15 minutes, short but steep) for an unobstructed sunrise; small entry fee of 10,000 kip at the temple.
items.name: Sunrise at Phou Si Mountain (6 AM)

items.details: Snack through the morning market: grilled beehive 5,000 LAK, mung bean cake 5,000 LAK, khao gee 5,000 LAK, hand-made noodle rolls 10,000 LAK, khao piak sen 15,000 LAK.
items.name: Luang Prabang Morning Market (7 AM)

items.details: Family-run khao soi stall east down the main street, near Wat Sene Temple; bowls 20,000 Kip plus coconut wedges in banana leaf.
items.name: Khao Soi breakfast (9 AM)

items.details: Group of temple buildings; courtyard entrance 20,000 LAK per person; spend an hour or two exploring.
items.name: Visit Wat Xieng Thong temple (10 AM)

items.details: Restaurant signed 'Green Papaya Salad' near L'Elephant; Lao green papaya salad (tam mak hoong), sun-dried pounded pork, house-made naem.
items.name: Som Tam lunch (12 PM)

items.details: Coffee break with river-view seating across the street, near Wat Xieng Tong temple; large Americano 20,000 Kip.
items.name: Saffron Coffee (2 PM)

items.details: Charcoal-grilled Laos sausage from a roadside grill along Kounxoua, near Wisdom Laos Guest House.
items.name: Sai Oua sausage (4 PM)

items.details: Option #1: evening street food market (curry, grilled fish, som tam, vegetarian buffets). Option #2 (recommended): Xieng Thong Phonsavahn Restaurant - order koi pa, fish salad, jaew kee pa, tom pla soup, kao neaw sticky rice, kaipen.
items.name: Dinner decision (6:30 PM)

items.details: Walking-street market on the main road; souvenirs and fruit shakes at the front of the market.
items.name: Luang Prabang Night Market (8 PM)

items.details: End the evening relaxing with a BeerLao by the riverside.
items.name: BeerLao riverside (9 PM)

itineraries.summary: Mark Wiens's hour-by-hour one-day DIY tour of Luang Prabang: sunrise at Phou Si Mountain (6 AM), morning market snacking (7 AM), khao soi breakfast (9 AM), temples (10 AM), som tam lunch (12 PM), coffee at Saffron (2 PM), sai oua sausage (4 PM), dinner decision (6:30 PM), night market stroll (8 PM), BeerLao (9 PM).
itineraries.title: Top 10 Things to Do in Luang Prabang [Your Perfect One Day Itinerary]

notes: Mark Wiens (@migrationology) runs migrationology.com with many travel food guides. Three genuine day-by-day itineraries extracted, all from his own site, all confidence=high: (1) 5-day Ghorepani Poon Hill trek in Nepal with named lodges and costs; (2) 2-4-day Karakoram Highway drive in Pakistan with named hotels, food stops, and a day-by-day plan; (3) hour-by-hour one-day Luang Prabang food itinerary in Laos. The Delhi travel guide and Zanzibar/Taipei guides are recommendation guides rather than day-by-day itineraries and were not extracted.
